name: mcp-gitlab
description: GitLab MCP server for MCP 2026-07-28: projects, MRs, files, reviews, pipelines, CI/CD, issues

settings.name: GITLAB_TOKEN
settings.description: GitLab personal access token (token mode). Optional after `mcp-gitlab auth login`; also accepts GITLAB_PAT, GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN, GITLAB_API_TOKEN

settings.name: GITLAB_AUTH
settings.description: Authentication mode: token (default) or oauth (OAuth 2.1 proxy; streamable-http only)

settings.name: GITLAB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
settings.description: Application ID of the GitLab OAuth app (oauth mode, or local sign-in on a self-managed instance)

settings.name: GITLAB_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
settings.description: Secret of the GitLab OAuth app (oauth mode)

settings.name: GITLAB_OAUTH_BASE_URL
settings.description: Public URL of this server, no trailing slash (oauth mode); redirect URI is <base>/auth/callback

settings.name: GITLAB_OAUTH_SCOPES
settings.description: Space-separated GitLab scopes required on every request (oauth mode; default api)

settings.name: GITLAB_OAUTH_JWT_KEY
settings.description: FastMCP JWT signing key, >=32 random chars (oauth mode; defaults to one derived from the client secret)
